annotations.title: Test trading-strategy code (EA, indicator, Python bot, written rules)

description: Reads trading-strategy code - an MT5/MT4 Expert Advisor or indicator (.mq5/.mq4/.mqh/.set), a Python trading bot (.py), a TradingView Pine Script (.pine), a cTrader cBot or NinjaTrader strategy in C# (.cs) or rules written in plain words (.txt) - and reports code faults: wrong server clock, modules never called, settings never used, missing include files, unchecked orders, martingale or grid sizing. Without an email it returns this free first read only and stores nothing. With the user's email it also opens a private Strategy Lab and returns its link: TrueTest rebuilds the strategy as plain-English rules, the user checks them on the lab page, then TrueTest backtests its own rebuilt copy on up to 16 years of prices with real costs, runs a luck check and keeps a forward watch. It never runs the uploaded code as given and never places trades. For a finished trade record use check_trading_record; compiled .ex5/.ex4 files cannot be read (test their Strategy Tester report instead). Files are kept up to 90 days; the lab 12 months after the user's last visit (https://truetest.uk/security).

filename.description: File name with its extension, e.g. MyEA.mq5, Utils.mqh, MyEA.set, bot.py, rules.txt
filename.title: Filename

ai_draft.description: True only if the user agreed that our AI service may read the code text to draft the rule card. It is run by an outside AI provider, on servers in a country the UK has not approved for data protection, so UK data protection rules may not protect the code the same way there. Emails, links, author lines and secret-looking values are removed first. False: a person writes it, within 2 working days.
ai_draft.title: Ai Draft

code.description: One file's text, if you are not using files
code.title: Code

email.description: The user's email address, only if the user wants the full backtest: it identifies the user's tests for the luck bar and the 3-free-labs-a-day limit. TrueTest sends no email to it for a request made through an assistant; the lab link comes back in this answer. Leave empty for the free first read alone
email.title: Email
